text:
I'm sorry your fiddle leaf fig is struggling. Unfortunately, repotting into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days after delivery isn't covered by our Plant Care Guarantee, so a replacement claim wouldn't qualify.

You can still get free care advice from a Plant Care Specialist by chat or email, and they may be able to help you save it. Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry. If the plant was actually damaged on arrival, tell me and I can offer to escalate that for review.
